title: The LayerZero implementation contract is the receiver of DAOs fees on cross-chain buy operations
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Whenever a cross-chain DAO is created via `createCrossChainERC20DAO()` or `createCrossChainERC721DAO()`, it assigns the `ownerAddress` as the `msg.sender`.
